messages:
Alex C: Kicking off the Shearwater POC perf run today. Plan: 3 phases (ramp, 15m steady, 5x micro-bursts). Need ops to confirm run window and a quick pricing note for burst capacity. attaching run config in-thread.

Maria G: Thanks — can you paste the concurrency profile and model variant? want to map to cost quickly.

Alex C: concurrency profile = [5, 50, 200] (ramp->steady->peak). model = rw-open-7b-quant. batch_size=8. TTL caching enabled for prefixes.

Samira: Security Q — Shearwater asked about KMS roundtrip added latency (we get asked that in the questionnaire). any measurements?

Riley (Ops): We can run the job 10:00-11:00 PT. Using dedicated pool d2-xlarge (4 gpus), autoscale disabled for test. I'll pin capacity so no cross-tenant noise.

Alex C: quick load config (wrk-style):
```
loadgen --targets 3 --ramp 120 --steady 900 --profile "poisson" --concurrency 200 --batch 8
```

Maria G: ok, rough pricing delta if they hit 200 qps for 5 minutes of bursts? include burst surcharge estimate.

Alex C: Rough math: steady cost ~ $0.045 / 1k tokens. Burst (reserved overflow) ~ +25% on top. For their burst volume (~2M tokens over 5m) extra =~ $90. I'll double-check with finance.

Samira: On KMS — typical asymmetric: HSM/KMS adds ~2-5ms on initial key unwrap, then negligible per-token. For our Private setups we recommend envelope keys + local cache; include that in the questionnaire response.

Riley (Ops): Runbook uploaded: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/shearwater/runbook — includes perf dashboard and trace links. I'll start the run at 10:02 PT and post status.

deploy-bot: perf-test job 1719002468 started on d2-xlarge (4 GPUs) by Riley (Ops).

Alex C: Starting phase 1 (ramp). tagging @Maria G @Samira for visibility.

Riley (Ops): Phase 2 steady @ 50 concurrency — p50~80ms, p95~220ms. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/shearwater/results

Maria G: Nice — what's the avg tokens/sec during steady?

Riley (Ops): steady tokens/sec ~ 12k (model gen short prompts). cost estimate trending close to projection.

Alex C: Now running micro-bursts — 5x 1m spikes to 200 concurrency.

Riley (Ops): burst #2 finished: p95 jumped to 480ms, p99 ~ 1.2s, brief queuing seen on route. KV cache warmed after first spike which helped subsequent ones.

Samira: Noted on queuing — for questionnaire: we observed transient queueing under short high-concurrency bursts; recommendation = small reserved buffer or canary fallback to a smaller model for tail control.

Maria G: Can you snapshot a heatmap for latency vs concurrency and attach? that'll help in the pricing deck.

Riley (Ops): Attached heatmap to dashboard link (see results). Quick summary: p95 remains <300ms up to ~120 concurrent; beyond that tail grows non-linearly.

Alex C: Post-run summary for Sales sync:
- Steady: 50 conc — p50 80ms, p95 220ms, tokens/sec 12k.
- Micro-bursts: peak 200 conc — p95 480ms, p99 1.2s.
- Root cause of tail: brief queueing + kernel contention on sequential attention for long prompts.
- Mitigation options: increase batch_size to 12 (lowers cost 6-8% per-token), enable prefix cache more aggressively, or route bursts to a cheaper model variant with lower latency.

Maria G: Great — for pricing and contract: recommend offering 10% discounted reserved commit for steady baseline, plus a capped burst surcharge (max $X / month). I'll draft numbers and send to finance.

Samira: I'll add the KMS/crypto blurb to the security questionnaire: initial key unwrap cost, envelope key caching, recommended KMS integration pattern.

Riley (Ops): Follow-ups: 1) run a 4-hour soak at 50 conc to validate sustained thermal behavior, 2) test with batch_size=12 and with smaller model fallback. I can schedule next run Wed morning.

Alex C: Awesome — thanks everyone. next steps: Maria will finalize pricing ask, Samira will update security responses, Riley to schedule soak. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: perf-test job 1719002468 completed. artifacts: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/shearwater/artifacts/1719002468.zip
